Travel Finland Without Connectivity Gaps

Sim2Me's eSIM for Finland connects you to one of Europe's most advanced digital networks – fast enough to live-stream the Northern Lights.

Why Choose Sim2Me?

  • Coverage on Elisa and Telia Finland.
  • 5G in Helsinki, Tampere, and Turku.
  • 4G LTE in Rovaniemi (Lapland) and Saariselkä.
  • Activate before your flight to Helsinki-Vantaa.

Network Performance in Finland

5G in major cities; 4G LTE across the country, including in the Finnish Lakeland and along the Arctic Highway to Utsjoki. Finland consistently ranks among the world's top countries for mobile internet speed.
